hypothesis: When high-yield credit under-performs what the S&P 500's own move implies over the last days (credit spread widening not matched by equities), US500 falls over the next days; when credit out-performs, US500 rises.
mechanism: Credit investors are better informed about default risk and react first; equity catches up with a delay of days. Slow, cross-asset information, not a chart pattern.
data_note: The declared source FRED BAMLH0A0HYM2 was unreachable from this environment on 2026-11-17 (every FRED request closed by the remote end), so the credit signal uses the HYG ETF (iShares iBoxx high-yield, dividend-adjusted close) from the Yahoo chart API, which tracks the same spread daily.

data.signal: Yahoo daily HYG and SPY adjusted closes 2007-04-11..2021-12-31 (IEF for one neighbour), cut at 2021-12-31

rule_main.residual: r_t = HYG daily return - beta_{t-1} * SPY daily return, beta = rolling 60-day OLS slope of HYG on SPY returns (known at t-1)
rule_main.signal: C_t = sum of r over the last W=5 days; lo/hi = 20th/80th percentiles of C over the 250 previous days (to t-1). C_t <= lo -> short US500; C_t >= hi -> long US500
rule_main.entry: open of ^GSPC on the next trading day t+1
rule_main.exit: open of ^GSPC on trading day t+1+H, H=3
rule_main.overlap: signals while a trade is open are skipped
rule_main.R: signed price change / D20, D20 = mean daily high-low range of ^GSPC over the 20 days before entry

costs: lab/r2/fp_costs.json us500: spread 0.4 at 7377 as bp of price at entry, slip_mkt_bps 0.2 per side, swap_long 5.5 %/yr /360 per calendar night held (covers the triple day), swap_short 0; gross, net, net with costs x1.5.
power_check: signal-only count of the main (no price of US500, no forward return): 463 non-overlapping signals 2008-07..2021-12 (n >= 250 reachable).
bars: PROTOCOL_V3 one-market bars on the main: n >= 250, PF net >= 1.12, t >= 2.5, >= 60 % of years positive, PF >= 1.04 at costs x1.5, neighbours' median PF >= 1.06, every-signal expectancy > 0 (every signal day, overlaps included), hold <= 5 days, random-entry null (2000 draws, same number of trades and same long/short count on random days) >= 97.5th percentile of net mean R; weekly correlation with the sum of the ten <= 0.30 (2014-2021, round6 correlation.py convention); deflated Sharpe probability >= 0.95 given the running total of configurations; sizing on 1,000-5,000 EUR (min lot 0.1, 1:200).
split: IS only (to 2021-12-31). VAL only if every bar passes and an independent re-implementation agrees.
